name: web-white-sales-analytics-widget-board-with-gauge-and-charts
title: Sales Analytics Widget Board
whatItIs: A pale grey board of white dashboard cards: a segmented semicircle gauge with channel performance, an average sales line chart with a dark tooltip, recent activity product rows, a top-three bar chart with hatched bars and a visitor heat grid with dark cells.
whatItMeans: Monochrome cards with one blue accent line make data feel clean, and varied chart shapes keep interest.
techniques: Segmented gauge with fading dark to light petals
Dark tooltip on a light chart
Heat grid of dark and light squares
Blue as the only colour for a key line

vocabulary.definition: A gauge made of rounded petal-like segments.
A grid of cells shaded by value.
A collection of dashboard cards shown together.
